policy.admission: Only SBB IR16 91-16-B-j26-1, agency 11, on the two September fixtures with existing OEVTP 450_IR_b association. Preserve the six original called stations in either complete direction. Pin three Bern and seven Zürich HB platform records. Clip only the reviewed Zürich HB–Langstrasse curve at the terminal projection. Bern platform 49 uses a source-curve spur connected solely to the reviewed eastern approach; ordinary Bern 9/12 retain the original operating point. No intermediate/repeated terminal use or unknown platforms. Fill only missing pairs after every complete raw context agrees, preserving all original calls, times, coordinates, permissions and prior paths.
policy.model: Explicitly inferred station-terminal centrelines on pinned FOT curves. Original station/topology attachment limits remain 120 m, terminal projections are limited to 75 m, and detour limits remain 4.5× / 3000 m. No running-track or switch certification. Original XTF bytes are unchanged; catalogue 2021-07-06, asset update 2025-01-18, checksum rechecked 2026-09-08; present alignment validity remains unconfirmed.

source.validityNote: Catalogue dates and verified bytes do not establish September 2026 alignment validity. Inferred infrastructure paths, not certified service running tracks.
source.transformation: Existing XTF parser with zero-metre Douglas–Peucker tolerance; collinear vertices may be removed. Approximate LV95-to-WGS84 transformation rounded to six decimals. Bern preserves original GTFS coordinates and rounds only final attachment endpoints to seven decimals.

scope: Exact SBB IR16 identity, six original ordered stations, three Bern and seven Zürich HB platform records, September fixtures only. Exact operating-point and source-segment identities; all complete input-pattern contexts must agree. Federal source date is not a certification of current running tracks or alignment.
